# Neat Systems

> Consultancy helping startups optimize systems during growth, from Seed through Series C.

Focuses on communication and information security problems that arise during rapid scaling, especially problems that cross disciplinary boundaries.

Can help clean up systems or improve capital efficiency when preparing to raise a series A, series B, or series C VC round. 

Can help you spend strategically while protecting your organization's values and culture when you raise a Seed, Series A, or Series B VC round.

## Main

- [Links](https://neatsystems.dev/links): Directory of Neat Systems and founder Margaret Fero's online profiles.
- [Tags](https://neatsystems.dev/tags): Index of content topics including startup growth, scaling, and root cause analysis.
- [Feed](https://neatsystems.dev/feed/feed.xml): RSS feed for Neat Systems blog and content updates.
